title: Task sync stage 1: atomic host-independent admissible subset apply
outcome: Task sync stage 1: atomic host-independent admissible subset apply
acceptance: Only the admissible subset applies: an incoming GOVERNING planning change to a task with engaged local execution (a live handoff; or an Active, unexpired claim; or, when the task has no claim row, non-planning active-run history), or one touching held state, is held until that work ends normally, and a mixed governing-plus-shared candidate is deferred atomically. Purely additive shared updates (notes, activity) may apply under a live claim without adopting claim, event or WorkItem ownership, and dormant native planning (a run with no execution history) may accept returned planning or reported completion without a seal or credit. This is Engram-only, with no TermAl attestation, per Greg's decision in memory rules-greg-full-sync-is-full-exchange-2026-11-07 rev 2. The complete relevant local readset (union graph, lifecycle/run/claim bases, newly connected races) is compared inside the same writer transaction, and shared changes, heads and the exact ImportReceipt commit together with no partial final graph or receipt.

An exact retry returns the exact receipt with no duplicate events or ids; a connected local race refuses while unrelated edits do not; reported planning or inert completion creates no live claim, grant, session or evaluation verification; the same native completed outcome keeps its seal and basis

Notes keep immutable ids with exact self-echo checks, activity updates keep original start/actor/origin binding and refuse rollback or equal-revision conflict, profile omission is not deletion, and re-export keeps unchanged committed bytes, proven by tests
